stage: Research only, P0 -> read-only joint diagnosis -> evidenced execution repair -> conditional intervention -> finite closed-loop
baseline: prior final geometry/storage repair and controller_server odom_topic=/odometry/lio; actual fixed Nav21.1.20, STVL2.3.4

groups.D: same consumer conditional oracle for already observed tracks
groups.Cprime: only if P1/P2 contracts support a minimal intervention; absent otherwise

original_gate: goal, zero actor contact, sampled full-envelope dynamic gap >=.047m, zero wall-envelope overlap; unchanged

new_diagnostic_contract.frame: odom=map only in original identity fixture, body velocities base_link
new_diagnostic_contract.static: known map occupied closed cells; reuse frozen R2 polygon-box geometry, report native perimeter disagreement
new_diagnostic_contract.dynamic: same-time prediction interpolation and existing circle/safety margin .02; source freshness checked at consume
new_diagnostic_contract.execution: separate raw nominal velocity/acceleration compliance from smoother-mapped realizability; missing controls/state/phase/delay bounds -> Unknown
new_diagnostic_contract.sweep: Lipschitz reserve or Unknown, not merely dense no-hit -> continuous proof

p1_inputs: bounded selected prior failed/safe candidate snapshots and deterministic native geometry/time/execution counterexamples; no control mutation

heldout.phase: unchanged default0; no prior diagnostic/tuning use

efficiency: separate safety and efficiency; >25% paired goal-time increase or any new timeout is material regression (project research must offer practical benefit); no significance claim for small paired sample
intervention_gate: Only if joint diagnosis identifies known hazards and accepts known feasible controls without contradicting native geometry/plant data; no giant finite penalty, no optimizer rewrite; if actual execution bounds unknown or existing API cannot express joint feasibility, stop intervention and mark unrun
stop: No new predictor/controller/owner/real hardware/push/merge. Stop after evidence and verdict; preserve failures, no post-hoc tuning or seed replacement.
